an4.114:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo. rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.114:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā ca hoti hantā ca khantā ca gantā ca.
an4.114:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā hoti,
an4.114:2.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo yamenaṃ hatthidammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāreti
an4.114:2.3: yadi vā katapubbaṃ yadi vā akatapubbaṃ,
an4.114:2.4: taṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasi katvā sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto suṇāti.
an4.114:2.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā hoti.
an4.114:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo hantā hoti?
an4.114:3.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato hatthimpi hanti hatthāruhampi hanti assampi hanti assāruhampi hanti rathampi hanti rathikampi hanti pattikampi hanti.
an4.114:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo hantā hoti.
an4.114:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo khantā hoti?
an4.114:4.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ bheripaṇavasaṅkhatiṇavaninnādasaddānaṃ.
an4.114:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo khantā hoti.
an4.114:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo gantā hoti?
an4.114:5.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo yamenaṃ hatthidammasārathi disaṃ peseti
an4.114:5.3: yadi vā gatapubbaṃ yadi vā agatapubbaṃ,
an4.114:5.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo gantā hoti.
an4.114:5.6: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo. rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.114:6.1: evameva kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuṇeyyo, dakkhiṇeyyo, añjalikaraṇīyo, anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an4.114:6.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sotā ca hoti hantā ca khantā ca gantā ca.
an4.114:7.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne aṭṭhikatvā manasi katvā sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.
an4.114:7.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sotā hoti.
an4.114:8.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti vyantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti. uppannaṃ vyāpādavitakkaṃ …pe… uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ …pe… uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti vyantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
an4.114:8.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu hantā hoti.
an4.114:9.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ, uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsikajātiko hoti.
an4.114:9.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu khantā hoti.
an4.114:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yā disā agatapubbā iminā dīghena addhunā yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ, taṃ khippaññeva gantā hoti.
an4.114:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu gantā hoti.
an4.114:10.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
